overall: Balanced pros/cons leading to justified Not Ship recommendation with strong health-care case, weakened by limited evidence base and presentation errors.

feedback.summary: You produced a balanced, well-structured report with a justified Not Ship recommendation. Your strengths are clear for/against discussion and strong healthcare case use. To improve, broaden evidence, extend decision guidance to all stakeholders, and improve presentation and referencing accuracy.
next_steps: Extend your decision guidance in DICUSSION: To Ship or Not to Ship to give specific recommendations for several stakeholders, not just you/Rachel and the company.
Strengthen evidence by adding more reputable sources with quantitative data to support business claims and balance the NHS and VW cases.
Add visual elements and proofread for grammar, and make your References complete and consistently formatted.

criteria.C1: You did well in INTRODUCTION linking quality safety vs business success to design and listing stakeholders including Rachel and the chip company. For Excellent, deepen significance of each issue and show both organisational context and stakeholder interests.
criteria.C2: You did well in DICUSSION: To Ship or Not to Ship giving objective depth e.g. competitive advantage and a clear Not Ship conclusion. For Excellent, add decision-making conclusions for several different stakeholders.
criteria.C3: You did well in The Most Ethical Path synthesising trade-offs e.g. short-term benefit outweighed by harm to support your conclusion. For Excellent, make coverage systematic and even for all stakeholders.
criteria.C4: You used relevant NHS and VW cases in References with qualitative and some quantitative detail. For Very good, broaden your range beyond four sources and add stronger evidence for business claims.
criteria.C5: You included abstract, introduction, body and conclusion. For Good, you need fluent error-free writing e.g. fix grammar in DICUSSION, add visual elements, and use consistently formatted relevant references.
